description: Fetches a single post and its comment tree by permalink. Returns the post plus threaded comments (author, body, score, replies) and an `after` cursor. The `permalink` is the one carried by any post result. Size a big thread with the three knobs: `limit` caps top-level comments (1-500, default 100), `depth` caps reply depth (1-10; `depth=1` is top-level only; absent is the full tree) and `sort` orders them (confidence = Reddit's best, top, new, controversial, old, qa). `limit=20, depth=1, sort='top'` reads the twenty best top-level comments and nothing below them, which keeps a 2,700-comment thread readable. `meta` echoes limit_used, depth_used and sort_used.

depth.description: Maximum reply depth, 1-10. depth=1 returns top-level comments only. Absent, Reddit's full tree is returned.

limit.description: Maximum top-level comments, 1-500 (default 100). A small value with depth=1 gives a readable summary of a large thread.

permalink.description: The post permalink path from a prior post result, e.g. '/r/programming/comments/abc123/some_title/'. Required.

sort.description: Comment ordering: confidence (Reddit's best), top, new, controversial, old or qa. Absent, Reddit's default for the thread.

name: reddit_post_comments
title: Get Post Comments
